en: Dependent on a state that has not yet arisen, a state that has not yet arisen arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that has not yet arisen, a state that has never arisen arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that has not yet arisen, states that have neither arisen nor ever arisen arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-arising, a state that is non-arising arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-arising, a state that is non-appeared arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-arising, states that are both non-appeared and non-arising arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on states that are neither arisen nor bound to arise, a state that is not arisen arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on states that are neither arisen nor bound to arise, a state that is not bound to arise arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on states that are neither arisen nor bound to arise, states that are both not arisen and not bound to arise arise.
Nine in the case of root ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance (avigata).
